qubex.description: MUX-level task that sweeps the readout capture delay with a fixed readout tone and picks a delay that centers the readout pulse in the capture window. It writes capture_delay (and capture_delay_word on QuEL-1) for every qubit of the MUX and updates the Qubex params files.

documentation.description: MUX-level task that sweeps the readout capture delay with a fixed readout tone and picks a delay that centers the readout pulse in the capture window. It writes capture_delay (and capture_delay_word on QuEL-1) for every qubit of the MUX and updates the Qubex params files.
